recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下組織被成片胞質淡粉紅的組織球樣細胞取代，其中夾雜成群的嗜酸性球（中央與右側的亮紅色細胞團），左上角殘存小淋巴球，這種「淡色組織球＋嗜酸性球」的組合提示蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-to-large histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Cell nuclei oval to reniform; grooves not resolvable at this magnification
Admixed clusters and aggregates of eosinophils, forming a dense focus in the center
Residual small dark lymphocytes at the upper left edge
describe_en: Section shows effacement by diffuse sheets of histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei, with a residual rim of small lymphocytes at one edge. Numerous eosinophils are scattered throughout and form a dense aggregate within the infiltrate. Nuclear grooves cannot be assessed at this low magnification, and no necrosis or granulomas are evident. Findings are suggestive of Langerhans cell histiocytosis, to be confirmed by CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are larger with emperipolesis, round nuclei without grooves, and are S100-positive but CD1a-negative.
Classic Hodgkin lymphoma contains scattered CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background rather than sheets of grooved CD1a-positive cells.
These lack a sheet-like population of CD1a-positive Langerhans cells and often show necrosis or organisms.
Dermatopathic change shows paracortical expansion with Langerhans and interdigitating cells plus melanin-laden macrophages, without sinus-filling sheets and eosinophilic aggregates.
